rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that food tastes delicious.

example.english: The char siu rice at this café is really delicious.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲叉燒飯真係好食。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 caa1 siu1 faan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this natural alternative when focusing especially on the food's good flavour.

example.english: This soup has a really delicious flavour.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tong1 jam2 lok6 hou2 mei6 wo3
